coverImage.caption: Biopolymers Online with Editor in Chief Alexander Steinbüchel provides a comprehensive overview of the occurrence, metabolism, and applications of all important biopolymer classes. This reference work treats processes for biotechnological production, isolation from organisms and modification, material properties and technical uses in areas such as ch...emical and food industries, medicine, pharmacy, and materials science.

single.issueText: Ahead of Print, unedited articles published online and citable. The final edited and typeset version of record will appear in the future.
